text: Shield drills beaten into the Earth ranks until raised shields answer the whistle of arrows without an order spoken.
Zhu Jun taught that a blow worth striking is worth striking through. Earth units hit with the full weight of the old drills.
The old general's marching cadences, measured against the drum until Earth columns eat the road.

The thunderclap charge Zhu Jun loosed at Wancheng, drilled into every Fire lance.
Fire columns advance at the old campaign pace: arrive first, choose the ground.
Plate quenched and re-fitted after every action, by the old general's standing order.
March, fight, and march again. Fire units are conditioned to the old general's punishing tempo.
Crossbow lines sited from the high ground, as the old general always placed them.
No volley wasted, no quiver short. Supply discipline as strict as any battle drill.
Pavise and posture drilled until Water lines shrug off the counter-volley.
Massed volleys timed to the drum, loosed as one, as the old general's manuals prescribe.
Metal companies trained to close distance at the wolf's pace, arriving with wind to spare.
Slip the blow, answer it. The old general's duelling footwork taught to whole companies.
Strike on the count, and the count never stops. Metal units cut to the old drum's rhythm.
The hammer stroke Zhu Jun saved for the breaking point, delivered by Metal's finest.
